name: V noch', kogda cvetjot likoris — Drugaja noch'
original_name: В ночь, когда цветёт ликорис — Другая ночь
source:
A fanmade adaptation of several short stories from the Higanbana series, originally published as booklets, reimagined in visual novel format.

These include: "The Inhuman Teacher", "Class Meetings At The Old School", and "Marie's Utopia".
translation:
粉丝根据《彼岸花》系列的几篇短篇小说改编的作品，最初以小册子的形式出版，后来以视觉小说的形式重新构思。

其中包括：《非人老师》、《老学校的班会》和《玛丽的乌托邦》。
